basis: EXAMPLE ONLY. A single-operator lab in Ontario, Canada, declared by the operator responsible for it. Data restricted to Canada or to Ontario may enter; data restricted to the United States may not, and no other country's restriction is satisfied here. Processing outside a production environment is not itself restricted. This declaration is the operator's authority for this deployment; it says nothing about what any customer agreement permits.
